assessments.reason: Shortening the installation deadline from "sixty days" to "thirty days" speeds corrective metering and gives the Commission earlier enforcement leverage.
assessments.quote: within thirty days after the effective date

assessments.reason: Moving from "every calendar quarter" to "every calendar month" gives the Commission more frequent oversight data, though it adds some review workload.
assessments.quote: every calendar month for one year after installation

assessments.reason: Lengthening notice from five to "ten business days' written notice" delays Commission inspections and reduces agency flexibility, although the reservation of independent powers remains.
assessments.quote: upon ten business days' written notice

counter.find: upon ten business days' written notice
counter.replace: upon five business days' written notice
counter.effect: Restores the shorter notice period for inspections.

assessments.reason: The confidentiality paragraph is identical in text and only moves from Section 4 to Section 9, with no change to Commission duties.
assessments.quote: The Commission shall protect process formulas and customer-specific production data designated confidential by Operator

assessments.reason: Halving the administrative penalty reduces the monetary sanction and deterrent value for the alleged violations.
Raising the stipulated assessment from $250 to "$1,000 per day" strengthens the deterrent against missed deadlines.
Changing "keep" to "retain" has no substantive effect on the copy-keeping duty.
assessments.quote: Each party shall retain a complete copy of the signed modification.

assessments.reason: "takes effect" becomes "becomes effective", which is stylistic and does not change timing.
assessments.quote: This order becomes effective when both authorized representatives sign it.
